Change has been successfully merged
Don't need this check twice. Can be limited to single validation call after ConfigManager creates its JSON. As that is the JSON which will be fetched by rest of the classes during execution.

This check is for an early return optimization. If the system config JSON itself is invalid, we can abort at this step instead of proceeding with building config maps, which will fail. I have measured this check and it takes 21ms.
This check is also done as `m_systemConfigJson` can be consumed via public API `getJsonObj()`
Acknowledged
Why not check each JSON at the time of formatting/creation itself and flag at that instance itself? That way we might not need this APi itself.

1. The "formatting/creation" is done by `buildConfigMapsForFru` API which operates on each FRU. The requirement is to validate the chassis specific JSONs.
2. I didn't want to overload the build config maps API with the validation logic, and keep building and validation blocks in separate methods.
Acknowledged
Just add some details to make it more clear what is meant be Chassis specific Jsons.
Done
Nit: mmandatory fields validation.
Done
Nit: optional fields validation.
Done
why this API not part of JsonValidator ?
This API's purpose is to validate chassis specific JSONs. `JsonValidator` is not aware of chassis concept. It only has a single public method to validate passed JSON object.
Acknowledged
validateConfigJson failes it throws an exception, but this api is noexcept, how to we handle if there any failures while json validation for any chassis ?
Handling that case is a "TODO" as specified by the "TODO" statement in Line 265.
then need to update API doxygen, how this API handles/updates any failure.
Addressed.

Why not catch the base exception here so that nothing goes beyond this API. This way we can ensure that API marked as noexcept does not fail.

I agree that there is a TODO mentioned but we can't have a patch set which knowingly can break the code in assumption that future code will fix that.
